title: Sinai and the Tent

summary.younger: At a mountain called Sinai, God gave his people his good laws and told them to build a tent where he would live among them.
summary.older: Rescued people are given a way to live. At Sinai God makes a covenant with Israel, gives the law, and has them build the tabernacle so that he can dwell among them.

added: Act Four (Exodus and Sinai) is two stops here: the rescue, then the law and the tent.
